title: ESV 66-Book Bible Question Bank
content_note: Original questions with references to the ESV. No outside biblical history, traditional authorship claims, church councils, or denominational catechisms are required. Not an official Crossway product.
question_style_note: This bank deliberately combines narrative recall with exact verse-word/name recognition. Recognition items ask which option occurs in the cited verse, not which option is a complete interpretation of the passage. A reference is part of the question.

difficulty_rubric.3: Detailed recall or a relatively frequent term at an exact verse.
difficulty_rubric.4: Less familiar narrative detail or a less frequent term at an exact verse.
difficulty_rubric.5: Obscure names or details, including rare terms at exact verse references.

difficulty_note: Editorial and frequency-based estimates, not empirically calibrated player difficulty.
reverence_policy: Treat the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit respectfully.
Do not invent competing or derogatory theological claims as distractors.
Do not use divine names or titles as interchangeable wrong answers.
Frame a biblical speaker’s words as that speaker’s words, not automatically as an endorsed doctrine.
Do not require post-biblical Trinitarian terminology to answer a question.

validation.note: Textual and structural validation completed. Difficulty is estimated; the bank has not undergone independent expert review or player testing.
